content.text: The NHL playoff picture enters its final week with little clarity yet in each conference's wild-card race.The Nashville Predators hold the second wild-card spot by a point heading into April 9's games. But the teams behind Nashville all hold a game in hand.AdvertisementIn the East, Philadelphia and Ottawa are the teams locked into the third spot in the Metro and the second wild-card, respectively.
